Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 10, 2026. Register online, by mail (postmarked by this date), or in person by 11:59 p.m. Uniformed service members and overseas citizens who are not yet registered have until October 19, 2026.
  • Early voting: October 22, 2026 to November 1, 2026. No early voting on October 25. Hours are 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. from Oct 22 to 24 and Oct 26 to 27, then 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. from Oct 28 to Nov 1. You can vote at any early voting site in your county.
  • Last day to request an absentee ballot by mail: October 30, 2026. This is the last day to request an absentee ballot and have it mailed to you. The state issues absentee ballots until noon on November 2. Completed ballots must arrive by 8 p.m. on Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Official election information: vote.gov
